lines: 💪 Decided to push on, not ready to hang up the boots yet
🏆 Won Player of the Month (April 2049)!
⚠️ Your contract is expiring!
🌍 England won the European Championship.
📋 Left out of the Netherlands squad for the European Championship. You watch it at home.
🤝 Pointed the coaching course at the captain. He is already correcting the gaffer
😴 Told the sleep guy that 2am is a lifestyle. Happier, marginally slower
🎤 Gave the media nothing to work with
⚽🏫 Postponed football academy plans
📝 Signed 1-year extension with Twente (€19k/wk)
